meta.name: x-article-publisher
meta.description: Publish Markdown articles to X (Twitter) Articles editor with proper formatting. Use when user wants to publish a Markdown file/URL to X Articles, or mentions "publish to X", "post article to Twitter", "X article", or wants help with X Premium article publishing. Handles cover image upload and converts Markdown to rich text automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 文章发布到 X 并自动排版
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常写 Markdown 并想一键发布到 X 文章。
copy.tagline_en: Publish Markdown articles to X with auto formatting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write in Markdown and want to publish to X Articles in one click.

howto.what: 把本地的 Markdown 文章发布到 X（Twitter）Articles 编辑器：自动解析格式、填写标题、粘贴为富文本并保存草稿。文章缺标题或封面图时，会先阅读内容帮你拟标题或生成封面图。不会自动公开发布。
howto.when: 当你想把 Markdown 文件或链接发布到 X Articles，或说出“publish to X”“post article to Twitter”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把 article.md 发布到 X 的 Articles，存成草稿不要直接发
帮我把《我的文章.md》发到 Twitter，标题你帮我起一个
say.note: 缺 H1 标题时，Claude 会阅读内容生成适合的标题。

say.text: 用隐藏浏览器模式发布这篇到 X，后台存为草稿
say.note: Claude 会以 headless 方式完成发布流程。

howto.what_en: Publishes a local Markdown article to X (Twitter) Articles editor: parses the file, fills in the title, pastes rich text, and saves it as a draft. If the title or cover is missing, it reads the content and generates suggestions. It never auto-publishes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to publish a Markdown file or URL to X Articles, or mentions phrases like 'publish to X', 'post article to Twitter', or requests help with X Premium article publishing.

say_en.text: Publish article.md to X Articles and save it as a draft, don't auto-publish.
say_en.note: Claude parses the file and opens the X Articles editor to save a draft.

say_en.text: Post my_article.md to Twitter and generate the title for me.
say_en.note: If no H1 exists, Claude reads the content and creates a title.

say_en.text: Use headless mode to publish this article to X and save as draft.
say_en.note: Runs the publish flow in the background.
